thread:
sarah-cs: Meridian (prod) is P1ing — seeing elevated p99 embeddings latency + intermittent 503s since ~03:10 PST. They report failures when seq_len > 1024. Ticket: https://jira.redwood/browse/MER-1123. Need engineering workaround + ETA.

lina-oncall: I'm on the alerts — pool3 GPUs saturating, OOMs on model open-encoder-xl-8k. Attaching brief logs.

sam-platform: @lina can you paste the log snippet? I can apply a routing override to fall back to a smaller variant and reduce batching. Will need owners to ack for tenant-level change.

lina-oncall: logs: ```OOM at kv_cache.c:142
alloc failed for kv_cache_size=1.9GB
stack: runtime/kv_prefetch -> kv_cache_alloc -> gpu_map```

kevin-runtime: I can ship a hotfix to short-circuit the aggressive KV prefetch and add a soft seq_len cap. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4678. If canary looks good we can roll to dedicated pools in ~30-60m.

sarah-cs: Customer needs concrete ETA and mitigation steps we can give them within 15m. They asked for a temporary fix window of 2-3 hours if possible.

alex-ml: Short-term: route to quantized variant open-encoder-xl-8k-q4 which reduces memory by ~40%. I'll prepare the model alias and run quick evals. Canary required before tenant routing.

sam-platform: Suggested plan (owners below):
1) Apply routing override for meridian-prod -> q4 variant (owner: sam-platform)
2) Reduce batch_target_tokens to 512 via feature flag (owner: sam-platform)
3) Deploy runtime patch to guard seq_len & disable prefetch (owner: kevin-runtime)
4) Monitor canary, then full rollout (owner: lina-oncall)
ETA: routing + batch toggle within 20m, patch + canary 45-60m.

maya-cs: I'll be the single point of contact with Meridian. Please @-me on each milestone so I can update them.

deploy-bot: build succeeded for pr/4678 on main — canary started in eu-west-1 (canary-id: can1234) :white_check_mark:

kevin-runtime: Canary metrics look promising — ~40% mem reduction, no OOMs observed in canary. p50/p95 for canary stable. Merging now.

sam-platform: Routing override applied for tenant meridian-prod -> open-encoder-xl-8k-q4. Batch_target_tokens toggled to 512. Monitor dashboard: https://console.redwood/tenants/meridian/metrics

lina-oncall: Observability update: error rate dropped from 4.8% -> 0.6%, p99 latency from 2.8s -> 1.2s after changes. Continuing watch.

sarah-cs: Meridian confirmed reduced errors and much better latency. They're asking for a postmortem and timeline for a durable fix.

kevin-runtime: I'll open RUN-7901 for the long-term KV prefetch redesign and seq_len handling. Tentative ETA: next sprint (1 week) for full rewrite; hotfixes will be backported if needed.

maya-cs: Thanks team — I'll update Meridian and close the incident after the postmortem is shared. :thumbsup:

sam-platform: Good work everyone. Leaving monitoring handoff with @lina for 4 hours watch window.

lina-oncall: Acknowledged — will escalate if any regressions.
